text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Summer training camp, the final day—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Now then,
let's take a look at the final results
of the "Breakout Umamusume Audition"—!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Hiyahâ!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —I came in... 5th place...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Breakthrough Umamusume Audition"—
It was a fan-voting event held this summer, presented by Kyoto Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, the Umamusume who finish in the top 5
based on the voting results will get special plushies
made in their likeness.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I never imagined that I'd actually make the rankings.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I barely squeaked in at 5th place, but even so... I'm really, really happy.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
The voting comments are...
all so warm and supportive, after all.

text_block_list.name: Vote Comment
text_block_list.text:
"Watching her run with everything she has gave me courage."
"Her dynamic with her Trainer hits right in the feels."
"Learning about the bond between those two makes me so happy."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—I can feel everyone's expectations
so vividly. ...I'm so happy.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Carrying everyone's expectations on my shoulders,
—and answering to Ai-san's feelings.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Beyond this—I will, without fail.
I want to hand you that golden bouquet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a voice tinged with determination yet wearing a gentle smile,
she looked at me, and I gave a small nod in return.
choice_data_list: I will definitely dedicate radiant glory to you.
I want to dedicate my brilliance to you, no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. Yes.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Even when summer draws to a close, we'll hold hands.
For the sake of our shared dream—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Let us dash through this.
Together...!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's give it everything we've got!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later.
That special plushie arrived.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Fufu, are you ready, then?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Here I go. Ready—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my!
Fufu, how wonderful. Hello there, little me—
